pages.text: The $(l:armors/sinner_robes)$(c)$(o)Sinner's Robe$() Helmet supports a high variety of masks based on the item inserted into its Ability Slot, with these being mostly stealth related - with the exception of the Spyglass, which works as goggles with Zoom. The various Wools will result in Cat masks which are effective against Phantoms; Terracotta blocks are Dog masks

that work against Skeletons; Sweet Berries and Rabbit Feet create effective Fox masks to catch Rabbits with; $(l:blocks/eyes)$(c)$(o)Eye blocks$() offer immunity against $(l:offsprings/stalker)$(c)$(o)Stalkers$(), $(l:blocks/remains)$(c)$(o)Remains$() reduce the visibility against Offsprings of the Risus; and the different Creature Heads increase stealth against their respective creature, with the Piglin Head and the Carved Pumpkin each making Piglins and Endermen neutral.
